sources.description: Beautifully designed components built using Radix UI and Tailwind CSS. Copy-paste, not npm install. Own the code.
Unstyled, accessible UI primitives for React. WAI-ARIA, composable, unstyled freedom. Used by Vercel, Supabase.
Completely unstyled, accessible UI components for React, designed to integrate beautifully with Tailwind CSS.
Ready-to-use foundational React components. Material Design, enterprise-grade, 50+ components.
An enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library. B2B, tables, forms.
Component system for building SaaS products with speed. Simple, modular, accessible.
Fully featured React components library. 100+ components, great DX.
Most popular, free and open-source Tailwind CSS component library. Minimal, built-in themes.
GitHub's Primer Design System using React. 23 packages, independently versioned.
IBM's open-source design system for products and experiences. React + web components, tokens, icons, grid, motion.
Adobe Spectrum design system. React Spectrum + React Aria + Spectrum tokens. Taxonomy, registry, 179 terms.
Industry-standard toolkit for scales, layouts, DOM/SVG/Canvas manipulation. The bespoke 10%.
D3 primitives in React components. 30+ packages, each 2-5kB gzipped. NOT a charting library — toolkit for BUILDING charts.
Compositional charting with sensible defaults. Declarative, simplest, covers common 80%. SVG.
Theme-able SVG/Canvas charts ready to drop into dashboards. Built on D3, server-render support, 9.1K+ docs.
Dynamic wizard for Angular that guides users through decision tree of questions — branching, async validations, route summaries, Material UI.

Marketing needs SSENSE 58/42 window like shadcn hero
Store needs Aritzia minimal — daisyui rapid prototyping

decisionMappings.reasoning: Density is posture: carbon 16-col grid tight gutters for compact, primer centered 640 for airy, mantine 100+ components for cozy default
Material = tokens: spectrum taxonomy (anatomy-terms, 179 terms), carbon tokens (colors, type, motion), shadcn own-the-code copy-paste, primer 23 packages independently versioned
Stack is story: carbon 16-col grid, decision-wizard branching logic, primer docs structure. 58/42 map/story, centered 640, breakout 1100
Data proof pairs viz best practices: d3 bespoke 10%, visx D3 primitives 30 packages 2-5kB, recharts declarative 80%, nivo SSR, ant table-first, carbon data-display
